pricing_change: 20% discount for SMB customers who prepay an annual contract (Starter and Growth plans)
expected_effect: Higher annual-plan mix and stronger upfront cash collection, with lower churn expected from annual lock-in.
actual_effect: Annual-plan mix and new SMB signups rose as predicted, but annual accounts expanded far less than monthly accounts. The discounted base price anchored customers and seat add-ons slowed.
revenue_impact: +22% new-logo revenue; -9% expansion revenue per account over 2 quarters
retention_impact: -3 pts net revenue retention at 12 months (94% to 91%)

pricing_change: Reduced the monthly event cap on the SMB Starter plan from 100k to 50k events with a hard cutoff
expected_effect: Push heavy Starter users to upgrade to the Growth plan, lifting average revenue per account.
actual_effect: Upgrades rose modestly, but a large share of capped users churned instead of upgrading, and support tickets about sudden cutoffs spiked.
revenue_impact: +4% SMB average revenue per account; -7% Starter-plan MRR
retention_impact: -5 pts logo retention among capped accounts

pricing_change: 25% discount on annual contracts for mid-market customers
expected_effect: More mid-market wins and faster deal cycles, with an acceptable margin give-up.
actual_effect: Acquisition increased and deals closed 11 days faster, but expansion revenue declined because discounted accounts resisted add-on modules priced at list.
revenue_impact: +18% new-logo revenue; -12% expansion revenue over 3 quarters
retention_impact: -6 pts net revenue retention at 12 months

pricing_change: 15% bundle discount for buying the Analytics and Automation modules together
expected_effect: Higher Automation attach rate and better retention through product stickiness.
actual_effect: Attach rate and retention both improved as predicted. Bundled accounts used more features and renewed at higher rates.

pricing_change: Extended the free trial from 14 days to 30 days for new signups
expected_effect: A longer evaluation window would raise trial-to-paid conversion.
actual_effect: Conversion fell. Extended trials let users lose momentum, and many never returned after week 2.
retention_impact: Trial-to-paid conversion dropped from 21% to 17% (-4 pts); no change in 6-month retention of converted accounts

pricing_change: 24-month contract option with a two-year price lock (no discount, renewal uplift capped at 3%)
expected_effect: Improve retention and give finance more predictable revenue.
actual_effect: Results matched expectations. About 35% of new mid-market deals chose 24 months, and renewal negotiations became noticeably smoother.
revenue_impact: +6% contracted ARR visibility; expansion revenue flat (0%)

pricing_change: 15% bundle discount for buying the Analytics and Automation modules together (relaunch of the earlier bundle offer)
expected_effect: Repeat the retention lift seen in the Q2 bundle experiment.
actual_effect: No measurable lift. The relaunch coincided with a full pricing-page redesign and new packaging layout, so it is unclear whether the bundle or the redesign drove buyer behavior.
revenue_impact: +1% net revenue per bundled account (not statistically significant)
retention_impact: +0.4 pts gross retention at 6 months (within noise)

pricing_change: 30% first-year discount for new SMB customers during the Q4 promotion
expected_effect: A large surge in new SMB logos with an acceptable margin hit.
actual_effect: Signups surged as predicted, but the promo cohort converted poorly to full price at first renewal and showed minimal add-on expansion.
revenue_impact: +31% new-logo revenue in Q4; -15% expansion revenue versus prior cohorts
retention_impact: -8 pts net revenue retention at first renewal

pricing_change: 3-year enterprise agreements with a 5% annual uplift cap and no upfront discount
expected_effect: Improve enterprise retention and make revenue more predictable.
actual_effect: Outcomes matched expectations. Several large accounts committed to 3 years, and procurement cycles did not lengthen.
revenue_impact: +11% average enterprise contract value; +4% expansion revenue
retention_impact: +4 pts net revenue retention at 12 months

pricing_change: Replaced the SMB Starter hard event cap with pay-as-you-go overage at $0.40 per 1,000 events above 50k
expected_effect: Recover revenue from heavy users without increasing churn.
actual_effect: Better than expected. Overage revenue exceeded the forecast and churn among heavy users fell, since accounts were no longer cut off mid-month.
retention_impact: +3 pts logo retention among heavy users

pricing_change: Raised the enterprise minimum contract price by 12% and required VP approval for any discount above 10%
expected_effect: Improve margins with minimal loss of deals.
actual_effect: Margins improved, but win rate slipped more than predicted in competitive deals against two named rivals.
revenue_impact: +8% average enterprise contract value; -5% enterprise new-logo count
retention_impact: No change in enterprise net revenue retention (0 pts)

pricing_change: Free 30-day guided pilot with a dedicated onboarding specialist for mid-market prospects
expected_effect: Higher pilot-to-paid conversion for mid-market deals.
actual_effect: Conversion beat expectations. Guided onboarding drove faster adoption, and pilot accounts reached key features in the first two weeks.
